changeSet.author: forwardmeasure
changeSet.sql: CREATE KEYSPACE IF NOT EXISTS datastreaming_journal WITH REPLICATION = {'class': 'NetworkTopologyStrategy', '${replicationDatacenter}': ${replicationFactor}}

changeSet.author: forwardmeasure
changeSet.sql: CREATE KEYSPACE IF NOT EXISTS datastreaming_snapshot WITH REPLICATION = {'class': 'NetworkTopologyStrategy', '${replicationDatacenter}': ${replicationFactor}}

changeSet.author: forwardmeasure
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS datastreaming_journal.messages (persistence_id text, partition_nr bigint, sequence_nr bigint, timestamp timeuuid, timebucket text, writer_uuid text, ser_id int, ser_manifest text, event_manifest text, event blob, meta_ser_id int, meta_ser_manifest text, meta blob, tags set<text>, PRIMARY KEY ((persistence_id, partition_nr), sequence_nr, timestamp)) WITH gc_grace_seconds = 864000 AND compaction = {'class': 'SizeTieredCompactionStrategy'}

changeSet.author: forwardmeasure
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS datastreaming_journal.tag_views (tag_name text, persistence_id text, sequence_nr bigint, timebucket bigint, timestamp timeuuid, tag_pid_sequence_nr bigint, writer_uuid text, ser_id int, ser_manifest text, event_manifest text, event blob, meta_ser_id int, meta_ser_manifest text, meta blob, PRIMARY KEY ((tag_name, timebucket), timestamp, persistence_id, tag_pid_sequence_nr)) WITH gc_grace_seconds = 864000 AND compaction = {'class': 'SizeTieredCompactionStrategy'}

changeSet.author: forwardmeasure
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS datastreaming_journal.tag_write_progress (persistence_id text, tag text, sequence_nr bigint, tag_pid_sequence_nr bigint, offset timeuuid, PRIMARY KEY (persistence_id, tag))

changeSet.author: forwardmeasure
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS datastreaming_journal.tag_scanning (persistence_id text, sequence_nr bigint, PRIMARY KEY (persistence_id))

changeSet.author: forwardmeasure
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS datastreaming_journal.metadata (persistence_id text PRIMARY KEY, deleted_to bigint, properties map<text,text>)

changeSet.author: forwardmeasure
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS datastreaming_journal.all_persistence_ids (persistence_id text PRIMARY KEY)

changeSet.author: forwardmeasure
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS datastreaming_snapshot.snapshots (persistence_id text, sequence_nr bigint, timestamp bigint, ser_id int, ser_manifest text, snapshot_data blob, snapshot blob, meta_ser_id int, meta_ser_manifest text, meta blob, PRIMARY KEY (persistence_id, sequence_nr)) WITH CLUSTERING ORDER BY (sequence_nr DESC) AND gc_grace_seconds = 864000 AND compaction = {'class': 'SizeTieredCompactionStrategy'}
